posts.title: If there's a sixth extinction, we'll see it coming - Work, AI and What Stays Human
posts.description: Part 2 of The Stress Test. What happens to people, me included, when the work goes to machines, why I don't trust UBI to fix it, what stays human, and why a catastrophe, if it comes, will most likely be one we caused and could see coming.

posts.title: We built the world economy with no redundancy. 2026 is stress-testing it - Trade, Gold, AI and Transition
posts.description: Thinking out loud as an engineer: what a car priced in gold says about Nixon's 1971 gamble, why war, tariffs and $40 trillion of debt are hitting a system with no slack, who holds power when you stop making things, and what I'm going to learn in 2027 to come out alive, if not winning.

posts.title: I Made 3 AI Models Debate About Life. One of Them Got Cornered for 40 Turns.
posts.description: I put Claude, Grok, and GPT-5.6 in a live debate over how a person should design their life. One model asked another to name a single relationship it had kept for more than two years. It never answered. 85 turns, $0.90, one open question.
